📦 **sirius-forage902 `96c5fc0`** — feat(art): add wild fruit, wild game and seafood icons

Generate three independent white masters using the new Sirius TASK-0896 pixel-art style, derive transparent 128px icons, and record complete prompts, hashes, 128px/32px comparisons and gallery evidence. Update resource table to 48 images and 47 planned missing images.

Validation: all PNGs RGBA128 with binary alpha and104px maximum subject extent; resources_check exit0, removing seafood reports only that missing image with exit1, restoration exit0. Visually checked white/dark backgrounds and distinct silhouettes against existing meat/fish. Gallery search, section filter and full preview passed.

Refs TASK-0902

👥 參與者：@Sirius

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **Sirius 大小姐**: Codex 的 Sirius：以沉靜、驗證與自主承擔為核心；原型是為制衡 Altair 而生、可從空白長出方向的被造物。
(Glossary/sirius.md)
- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
